data.gender_notes: Elnar is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the ancient names El and Nar, meaning 'light' and 'star' respectively. In some cultures, Elnar is believed to represent the light of God or a guardian angel. The name Elnar carries the meaning “Light, star” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elnar usually hope their child will grow to embody light, star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine guidance and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Elnar belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, star.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elnar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אלנאר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלנאר הוא שם שמורכב מ'אל' ו'נאר', שמשמעותו אלוהים הוא נאור לעזר. השם נגזר מהשפה העברית ומשמש כזכר לנוכחות האלוהית בחייו של האדם.

in_greek.name: Ελναρ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Ελναρ είναι όνομα που προέρχεται από τις εβραϊκές ρίζες και σημαίνει Ο Θεός είναι φως βοηθείας. Στην παράδοση των Χριστιανών, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει τη φώτισή του Θεού στη ζωή του ανθρώπου.

in_latin.name: Elnar
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Elnar derivatur ex radicibus hebraicis et significat Deus est lumen adiutorium. In traditione Christiana, hoc nomen repraesentat illuminationem Dei in vita hominis.

in_english.name: Elnar
in_english.meaning: God is my light and help
in_english.long_meaning: The name Elnar originates from Hebrew roots, specifically from 'El' meaning God and 'nar' meaning light or help. In Christian tradition, Elnar symbolizes the divine guidance and assistance in one's life. It reflects the biblical concept of God as the light of the world and the source of all help and salvation.
